name: MEDROXIPROGESTERONE / ESTRADIOL INJECTABLE SOLUTION WITHOUT SYRINGE 1 AMPOULE
description: The combination of medroxyprogesterone and estradiol injectable solution, usually at a dose of 25 mg/5 mg per vial, is a monthly contraceptive. It is available under several brand names in Mexico, and although the original presentation may come without a syringe, it is more commonly available in prefilled syringes. If discomfort persists, consult your doctor.
